svg.title: Acquire single-nanowire μ-PL at 4 K
svg.desc: Near-IR μ-PL with a continuous-wave semiconductor laser, nonresonant above the InP band gap; common method typically uses 640 nm. Long-working-distance objective collects the emission, detected by a nitrogen-cooled InGaAs linear array through a monochromator. Liquid-helium continuous-flow cryostat. Excitation power and integration time for individual traces are not supplied. Qualified action/instrument schematic; hardware dimensions and unreported preparation settings are not inferred.

g.text: Optical-path cue; no spectral result drawn
Typical excitation wavelength: 640 nm (typical; not separately restated for each plotted trace)
High resolution monochromator focal length: 1 m (for highest-resolution experiments)
